question: Q2 necessity of the C3 pin (w4 advice; a,c differ by DY3,DY11)
number: NECESSARY. q1 (a1,d1) is where the difference is born: d1^d1' = ror(a1^(a1+8),16) is nonzero for every a1, so equal d2/b2 can never come from 'no difference' and must be cancelled later. Pin freedom per coordinate (others at record, all 2^32 values): a1 -> {a1 both=1 d2only=1 b2only=0}; d1 -> {d1 both=1 d2only=15 b2only=0}. Single-bit flips of a1: 1/32 keep d2 equal, 0/32 keep b2, 0 keep digest words 0,2,5,7; of d1: 4/32, 0/32, 0; random replacement 0/2000 keep both. Only 1 of 29 carry runs fits the profile.
notes: Universe cell blake3-r2|C3.q1|step|Q2. Own tests: necessity.py (C3 and the 2-round E half re-implemented, validated: record pin -> equal d2/b2, words 0,2,5,7 equal in 64/64 trials) and axis.c (exhaustive 2^32 scan per pin coordinate, others at the record value; (a1,d1,c1,b1) is a bijection with (X3,X7,X11,X15) given w4). 'Necessary' = equal b/d outputs are not a property of random constants (random replacement 0/2000) and the pin is exactly the cube above; a single-coordinate scan is a local test around the record, not the global solution count (global: 64 pins per realizable cell, 8 cells, record profile; see the Q4 rows). Quarter attribution is by which equality the quarter carries; all four rows come from the same tests.
